def review(self,owner,sid):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            _,s,_=self._load(db,owner,sid)
            if s.status!='complete':raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_review_not_available')
            topics={t.anchor_id:t for t in s.plan}
            from job_agent.resume_workspace.learning import withdrawn_questions
            withdrawn=withdrawn_questions(db,owner,sid)
            comparison=None
            if s.prior_session_id:
                try:_,previous,_=self._load(db,owner,s.prior_session_id)
                except (WorkspaceNotFound,WorkspaceConflict,InvalidProvenance):previous=None
                prior_withdrawn=withdrawn_questions(db,owner,s.prior_session_id)
                old_topics={t.anchor_id:t for t in previous.plan} if previous else {}
                old_turns={t.question.topic_id:t for t in previous.turns} if previous else {}
                new_turns={t.question.topic_id:t for t in s.turns}
                same_model=previous and (s.mode,s.provider,s.model,s.version_hash,s.jd_text)==(previous.mode,previous.provider,previous.model,previous.version_hash,previous.jd_text)
                comparable=[k for k in new_turns if k in old_turns and same_model and
                    new_turns[k].question.question_id not in withdrawn and old_turns[k].question.question_id not in prior_withdrawn and
                    topics[k].points==old_topics[k].points and topics[k].aliases==old_topics[k].aliases and
                    new_turns[k].question.prompt==old_turns[k].question.prompt and
                    new_turns[k].question.focus_id==old_turns[k].question.focus_id and
                    [(r.snapshot_id,r.path,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash) for r in new_turns[k].question.references]==
                    [(r.snapshot_id,r.path,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash) for r in old_turns[k].question.references] and
                    (new_turns[k].evaluation.method_version,new_turns[k].evaluation.assessment_mode)==
                    (old_turns[k].evaluation.method_version,old_turns[k].evaluation.assessment_mode)]
                comparison={'prior_session_id':s.prior_session_id,'basis':'last answered turn per identical question/references/rubric/aliases/model/evaluation method; reference only',
                    'status':'comparable' if comparable else 'not_comparable','topics':[
                        {'topic_id':k,'before_covered':len(old_turns[k].evaluation.covered_ids),
                         'after_covered':len(new_turns[k].evaluation.covered_ids),'total':len(topics[k].points)} for k in comparable],
                    'warning':'题目或评价条件不一致时不计算提升；词面要点变化不能证明能力或真实教学效果。'}
            return {'session_id':sid,'scope':'规则参考' if s.mode=='local_demo' else '模型参考，非真实性证明',
                'practice_comparison':comparison,
                'track':s.track,'source_boundary':'通用知识/源码实现/个人贡献分别判断；源码存在和测试文件不代表已运行或本人完成。',
                'weaknesses':[{'topic_id':t.question.topic_id,'question':t.question.prompt,'missing':t.evaluation.missing_ids} for t in s.turns if t.evaluation.missing_ids and t.question.question_id not in withdrawn],
                'code_references':[r.model_dump(mode='json') for t in s.turns for r in t.question.references if r.scope=='private_project'],
                'turns':[{'question_id':t.question.question_id,'question':t.question.prompt,'answer':t.answer,'assessment_withdrawn':t.question.question_id in withdrawn,
                    'covered':[topics[t.question.topic_id].points[k] for k in t.evaluation.covered_ids],
                    'missing':[topics[t.question.topic_id].points[k] for k in t.evaluation.missing_ids],
                    'claim_needs_evidence':t.evaluation.claim_needs_evidence,'note':t.evaluation.note,'decision':t.decision.action} for t in s.turns],
                'assessment_details':[{'question_id':t.question.question_id,'mode':t.evaluation.assessment_mode,
                    'method_version':t.evaluation.method_version,'semantic_assessments_present':bool(t.evaluation.point_assessments),
                    'points':[a.model_dump() for a in t.evaluation.point_assessments]} for t in s.turns],
                'warning':'未覆盖可能是表达或规则识别问题，不代表没有能力；个人经历需补充材料，当前未独立核实。'}

## 当前有界证据交接

鉴权evidence/retrieve或RetrievalInterviewEngine→InterviewTools.retrieve_pack→规则计划→原Registry/Policy/Executor→引用校验→EvidencePack。私有owner/project/snapshot服务绑定；公共固定条目版本。最多2搜索/5工具/8000字符整段quote/20秒协作时限/32768模型输入token预留上界，场内18工具继续有效。大段省略保留原因，可在同计数内读取完整有限行；不伪造截断引用。子工具取父deadline和自身timeout的较早者，不保证GPU硬中断。

Pack保留两轮、显式读取、可信范围、候选/语义待判/缺失/停止原因。没搜到不等于语料无答案；个人贡献和运行成果不能凭源码认定。limited_source_only不等于supported，C1仍未独立核实。内部持久化最多10包，Evaluator/Interviewer消费同一身份与状态摘要；活动HTTP字段白名单不公开完整pack/rubric。执行State/事实审查已接下节S4，语义充分性仍待核对。

完成复盘资源单独post_review执行，最多2工具，不冒充场内18次；保留UI正文与独立trace。状态事务内私有/公开引用校验复用当前DB连接，修复真实后台worker提交与嵌套读的锁等待。375相关回归及真实模型/纯规则各6 pack和8流程检查通过，原373通过但HTTP失败记录保留；未新跑全仓或浏览器。[详细报告](../devlog/EXPAND-S3.md)。

## 总Spec更新规则

每个增量结束，将已核实变化合并进本页/对应主题章节，更新入口、数据合同、调用/状态流、能力边界和学习顺序，并链接增量Spec、实际代码及验证记录。实现但未验证的内容标implemented_unverified；未做内容保持planned/deferred。

基线文档保留原日期。新增较大主题时独立成章，在本页串联。当前说明不能只堆阶段链接却仍把旧架构当最新状态。

此前相关基线246、预热后264、前端状态逻辑13、评测静态合同9通过；不是相加后的新套件成绩。全仓首采集缺Streamlit2 errors；补UI后839/45/50（59.79s），45项=41缺历史资源/2 Redis/1无Git/1本次Qwen回归，后者已修复定向通过；原失败保留，没有宣称全仓全绿。未新跑浏览器/前端构建。

S2历史子增量3相关306通过17.76s，真实重排HTTP7检查/7查询/2面试入口及真实模型双进程重启通过；身份测试随机chunk排序空操作断言的305/1原失败保留。后续协作与PG见S4/S5实际结果；独立语义泛化/人工及Redis切片仍未验。

追加G flat BM25后开发诊断339调用/0错误，20dev/12独立test未评分。所有统计保留AI候选及小语料限制。临时fixture业务UUID新建，最终可重放索引/scope身份需S8补，当前不承诺bit级重现排名。

## 当前协作增量

两条原图现在携带SharedRunState，节点消费可信源身份/最新反馈/证据ID/预算与有界事件，并随既有仓储payload/checkpoint保存。模型只见必要投影；Writer历史裁到最近一稿，Reviewer只见原事实和当前稿。改写增加逐断言C1摘录映射与中文成果/否定冲突等门禁；相同坏稿提前停，Reviewer明确needs_input不被改成重试。CAS/lease防过期执行覆盖，采纳重查父版/草稿/事实与审查，仍是新C1。

面试逐要点状态/回答引文和同feedback_id驱动后续动作；活动视图仍白名单。完整事实省略明确context_incomplete，错误/不确定不算covered。运输未知保留model_inflight且不自动重放，已知坏JSON/schema另行失败；相同topic不足以比较，需同题面/引用/评价条件。

最后相关435项通过；新增离线文本provider不改旧Transformers适配，真实Qwen7B两个pilot/HTTP已跑，反馈改变追问，未批准改写不能采纳。12例×3路径×3重复108行/239次真实调用完成，未得到可用改稿增益，额外审查更耗调用；保留负结果，继续简单规则/人工审批默认。小消融6次/事后口语控制均已跑，不能声称独立泛化或正常改写质量达标。评价模型实际有解释误读，明确model_semantic_unverified，人工盲审仍未验。[实际报告与30分钟导读](../devlog/EXPAND-S4.md)。

    def answer(self,owner,sid,request):
        hashed=digest(request.model_dump_json(exclude={'allow_external_processing','request_key'}))
        with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            row,s,_=self._load(db,owner,sid)
            old=db.execute('SELECT * FROM rw_interview_answers WHERE session_id=? AND request_key=?',(sid,request.request_key)).fetchone()
            if old:
                if old['request_hash']!=hashed:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_answer_key_conflict')
                return False # Never re-dispatch a saved answer automatically.
            if s.status!='active' or s.pending is not None:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_not_ready')
            if s.revision!=request.expected_revision or s.current.question_id!=request.question_id:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_question_changed')
            s.pending=PendingAnswer(request_key=request.request_key,answer=request.answer);s.next_node='evaluator'
            sync_interview(s,owner)
            raw=s.model_dump_json()
            db.execute('UPDATE rw_interviews SET state_json=?,state_hash=? WHERE session_id=?',(raw,digest(raw),sid))
            db.execute('INSERT INTO rw_interview_answers VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(sid,request.request_key,hashed,'pending'))
            return True

    def claim(self,owner,sid):
        with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            row,s,v=self._load(db,owner,sid)
            if row['execution_token'] and row['lease_until']>time():raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_in_progress')
            if s.model_inflight:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_uncertain_model_call')
            if s.status!='active' or not s.pending:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_not_resumable')
            token=uuid4().hex
            execution=sync_interview(s,owner)
            if execution.execution_token is not None:execution.attempt+=1
            execution.execution_token=token;execution.lease_until=time()+600
            db.execute('UPDATE rw_interviews SET execution_token=?,lease_until=? WHERE session_id=?',(token,time()+600,sid))
            return token,s,v

        sync_interview(state,owner)

        with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:

            db.execute('UPDATE rw_interviews SET state_json=?,state_hash=?,lease_until=? WHERE session_id=?',(raw,digest(raw),time()+600,sid))
            if previous.pending and state.pending is None:
                db.execute("UPDATE rw_interview_answers SET status='complete' WHERE session_id=? AND request_key=?",(sid,previous.pending.request_key))

    def finish(self,owner,sid,revision):
        with self.workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            row,s,_=self._load(db,owner,sid)
            if s.status=='complete':return
            if s.revision!=revision:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_question_changed')
            if s.pending or s.model_inflight or row['execution_token']:raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_in_progress')
            s.status='complete';s.current=None

            raw=s.model_dump_json();db.execute('UPDATE rw_interviews SET state_json=?,state_hash=? WHERE session_id=?',(raw,digest(raw),sid))

## Outbox与Streams（S6）

复用旧Redis transport连接/group/ACK/监控原语，新增持久重领游标、近似MAXLEN10000、缺group重建。ACK不删除Stream；Redis信息丢失依PG未完成任务/Outbox显式对账，最后发送租约丢失也能收终态。坏/未知/失败消息归档定位+安全码+digest（最多1000条），不存正文；CLI inspect/reconcile可查可处理，失败重建用新请求键。lag/pending/保留、发送/耗尽和任务失败分开报告。

同schema在PG固定polling或redis；Redis模式拒绝内嵌轮询。维护切换要求无QUEUED/RUNNING，轮换authority作为执行代次，即使A→B→A旧进程仍被fence并需重开。私有main与独立CLI同配置，SQLite仍默认；生成模型沿用S4未知结果保护，不入索引重放队列。真实PG/Redis、原HTTP、独立进程故障、真实Qwen链及前端构建已有证据；不等于生产SLA/零丢失。完整ER、时序、矩阵与30分钟导读见[EXPAND-S6](../devlog/EXPAND-S6.md)。

## 当前检索架构与合同

`main.create_app → RetrievalRuntime.from_env → create_resume_app → CodeRAGService/PublicKnowledgeService → RetrievalInterviewEngine/InterviewTools`。环境示例见workbench.env.example；EMBEDDING=disabled为默认，local_qwen须有本地目录、可用设备与依赖。显式无效配置启动失败；合成demo不自动读私有配置。

代码源先按owner/project/snapshot检查，保持AST/符号/静态边，实际BM25和Dense候选用既有RRF；公共资料不含私有rubric。配置dense时公共service默认Hybrid，未配置默认BM25；HTTP显式method可做单路对照。引用仍绑定原文hash/行号/固定版本，自述不升级独立核实。

索引身份绑定可信scope、实际编码文本/顺序、parser/splitter版本、模型权重配置revision、维度/归一化/query模板/token上限/encoder版本。SQLite复用原表；PG按不可变publication和manifest键存取vectors；旧不完整键不复用。向量载荷完整性与维度/有限值/非零校验保留。

代码向量在build/索引任务的事务外计算，随后在同SQLite事务经原publish_guard发布chunks/edges/vectors；编码失败保留旧索引，旧attempt被fencing拒绝。公共doc/question在启动预热，小语料内存缓存按manifest隔离。正式后端在线查询不隐藏全量文档编码：缺当前向量时dense提示重建/预热，Hybrid明确BM25降级；完整性损坏仍拒绝。

能力接口鉴权后给出真实dense/rerank加载身份、默认方法、构建位置、预算配置和quality_verified=false。默认重排关闭；显式本地RERANK_PATH加载后对Hybrid/code_aware启用，可逐请求rerank=false对照。retrieval_trace-2包含manifest/config身份、两路/融合/重排前后ID、重排logit语义/错误/耗时、字符与token截断、整段quote预算省略和最终引用ID；完整S8事件合同待做。

模型为本地Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B/1024维/l2/cuda:0，最大输入1024 token、batch8；长块可能截断，没有硬中断GPU保证。另已真实运行本地mmarco-mMiniLMv2-L12-H384-v1 CrossEncoder，512-token pair、batch8，Identity激活输出raw logit，只代表排序。模型文件/软件身份固定，加载只本地且无推理外发。公共向量仍内存缓存，重启需预热；新语料/过滤子集未预热显式降级。真实双进程Qwen重启复用与L2范数已验证。

两检索路径共用RetrievalSettings：每路20候选、融合30、重排30、最终请求≤20（默认5）、关系≤8、整段quote预算24000字符；重排每段输入≤6000字符且pair≤512 token。预算省略完整段，不伪造截断引用。RRF k=60。CodeRAG保持符号优先，关系仍有界；纯Hybrid不混入符号/关系，用于隔离算法对照。

重排失败/缺分数/非有限值显式保留原序和分数，不编假得分；向量操作失败时Hybrid显式BM25降级，strict Dense报错，hash/引用/向量形状的完整性错误仍硬拒绝。可选重排与默认关闭Embedding都能回滚，不改来源、审批或C1。

冻结20dev上真实A—F共306次调用无错误，A—D同块/同预算/同K；额外flat BM25隔离切块，原始结果与负结果保留。此数据为AI候选、仅17可回答（代码子集8），已知语料域控制，不是自动路由或人工语义质量。小样本Dense=Hybrid、重排仅首位/MRR略升且更慢、关系未增覆盖且MRR下降；独立test未评分，不宣传泛化收益。

        row=db.execute(f'SELECT *,lease_until>{DB_NOW} AS live FROM v3_tasks WHERE task_id=%s FOR UPDATE',(claim['task_id'],)).fetchone()

            raise WorkspaceConflict('task_lease_lost')
        return row

def __init__(self,dsn,*,schema='job_agent_v3'):
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}',schema):raise ValueError('project_schema_invalid')
        import psycopg
        from psycopg import sql
        from psycopg.rows import dict_row
        from psycopg_pool import ConnectionPool
        self.dsn=dsn;self.schema=schema
        # Same native driver/row/transaction pattern as legacy PG, distinct model/schema.
        with psycopg.connect(dsn,autocommit=True) as conn:
            conn.execute(sql.SQL('CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {}').format(sql.Identifier(schema)))
        self.pool=ConnectionPool(dsn,kwargs={'row_factory':dict_row,'options':f'-c search_path={schema},pg_catalog'},
            min_size=1,max_size=8,open=False)
        self.pool.open(wait=True)
        with self._connection(write=True) as db:
            db.execute("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(%s,0))",(schema+':schema',))
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS v3_schema_migrations(version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,ddl_hash TEXT NOT NULL)')
            prior=db.execute("SELECT ddl_hash FROM v3_schema_migrations WHERE version='project-slice-1'").fetchone()
            expected=sha256(DDL.encode()).hexdigest()
            if prior and prior['ddl_hash']!=expected:raise WorkspaceConflict('project_schema_migration_required')
            if prior is None:
                db.execute(DDL);db.execute('INSERT INTO v3_schema_migrations VALUES (%s,%s)',('project-slice-1',expected))

        if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}',schema):raise ValueError('project_schema_invalid')
        import psycopg
        from psycopg import sql
        from psycopg.rows import dict_row

        self.dsn=dsn;self.schema=schema

def search(self,query,*,kind='doc',method=None,limit=5,tags=(),rerank=None,_prewarm=False):
        method=self.default_method if method is None else method
        if not query.strip() or len(query)>600 or kind not in ('doc','question') or method not in ('tag','bm25','dense','hybrid') or not 1<=limit<=20:raise WorkspaceConflict('knowledge_query_invalid')
        # Search metadata remains separate from repository.reference's original quote.
        records,chunks,lookup=self._pool(kind,tags)
        index=BM25Index();index.add(chunks)
        sparse=[r for r in index.search(query=query,limit=self.settings.sparse_candidates) if r.score>0]
        used=method;warnings=[];dense_hits=[];manifest_key=None
        if method=='tag':
            from job_agent.knowledge.contracts import RetrievedChunk
            scores=[(c,sum(tag.casefold() in query.casefold() for tag in lookup[c.chunk_id][0].tags)) for c in chunks]
            ranked=[RetrievedChunk(chunk=c,score=float(score),rank=i+1,retrieval_method='tag') for i,(c,score) in enumerate(sorted(scores,key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[0].chunk_id))) if score>0]
        elif method in ('dense','hybrid') and self.embedding_backend is not None:
            try:q=list(self.embedding_backend.embed_query(query)) if chunks else []
            except Exception as exc:
                if method=='dense':raise WorkspaceConflict('public_embedding_backend_failed') from exc
                fallback=self.search(query,kind=kind,method='bm25',limit=limit,tags=tags,rerank=False)
                fallback.update(method_requested=method,method_used='bm25_fallback',warnings=['public_embedding_backend_failed'])
                fallback['retrieval_trace']['dense_error']='public_embedding_backend_failed'
                return fallback
            if chunks and not valid_vector(q):raise WorkspaceConflict('public_query_vector_invalid')
            try:spec=declared_identity(self.embedding_backend).with_dimension(len(q)) if chunks else None
            except ValueError as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('public_query_vector_invalid') from exc
            manifest=manifest_for(chunks,corpus_kind='public_knowledge',scope=('public',kind),
                                  parser_version='public-entry-1',splitter_version='entry-title-body-tags-1',embedding=spec) if chunks else None
            corpus=manifest.key if manifest else None;manifest_key=corpus
            with self._lock:
                vectors=self._embedding_cache.get(corpus)
                if vectors is None:
                    if chunks and getattr(self.embedding_backend,'require_prebuilt',False) and not _prewarm:
                        if method=='hybrid':
                            fallback=self.search(query,kind=kind,method='bm25',limit=limit,tags=tags,rerank=False)
                            fallback.update(method_requested='hybrid',method_used='bm25_fallback',warnings=['public_dense_index_needs_prewarm'])
                            return fallback
                        raise WorkspaceConflict('public_dense_index_needs_prewarm')
                    try:vectors=self.embedding_backend.embed_documents([c.text for c in chunks]) if chunks else []
                    except Exception as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('public_embedding_backend_failed') from exc
                    dimension=len(q)
                    if len(vectors)!=len(chunks) or any(not valid_vector(v,dimension) for v in vectors):
                        raise WorkspaceConflict('public_vector_dimensions_invalid')
                    # Never cache unvalidated vectors or an empty corpus.
                    if len(self._embedding_cache)>=4:self._embedding_cache.clear()
                    if chunks:self._embedding_cache[corpus]=vectors
            dimension=len(vectors[0]) if vectors else 0
            if chunks and (len(vectors)!=len(chunks) or dimension!=len(q) or any(not valid_vector(v,dimension) for v in vectors)):
                with self._lock:self._embedding_cache.clear()
                raise WorkspaceConflict('public_vector_dimensions_invalid')
            dense=InMemoryVectorIndex();dense.add(chunks=chunks,vectors=vectors)
            hits=[r for r in dense.search(query_vector=q,limit=self.settings.dense_candidates) if r.score>0]
            dense_hits=hits
            ranked=hits if method=='dense' else reciprocal_rank_fusion(dense_results=hits,bm25_results=sparse,
                limit=self.settings.fusion_candidates,k=self.settings.rrf_k)
        else:
            if method=='dense':raise WorkspaceConflict('local_embedding_not_configured')
            ranked=sparse
            if method=='hybrid':used='bm25_fallback';warnings.append('semantic_embedding_not_configured')
        ranked=ranked[:self.settings.fusion_candidates];fused_ids=[h.chunk.chunk_id for h in ranked]
        enabled=rerank if rerank is not None else (self.reranker is not None and method=='hybrid')
        ranked,rerank_trace=apply_rerank(query,ranked,reranker=self.reranker,settings=self.settings,enabled=enabled)
        if rerank_trace['rerank_error']:warnings.append(rerank_trace['rerank_error'])
        if rerank_trace['rerank_applied']:used+='_rerank'
        ranked,budget_trace=output_budget(ranked,limit=limit,settings=self.settings)
        if budget_trace['budget_omitted_ids']:warnings.append('context_budget_omitted_whole_spans')
        hits=[]
        for hit in ranked:
            entry,version=lookup[hit.chunk.chunk_id];reference=self.repository.reference(entry,version,used)
            hits.append({'entry':public_entry(entry,version),'reference':reference.model_dump(mode='json'),'score':hit.score,
                'supports_claim':'needs_judgment','source_note':'本项目整理摘要/原创练习，非官方原文镜像或个人经历证据。'})
        return {'hits':hits,'method_requested':method,'method_used':used,'warnings':warnings,
                'retrieval_trace':{'schema_version':'retrieval-trace-2','index_identity':manifest_key,
                    'config_identity':self.settings.key,**budget_trace,**rerank_trace,
                    'sparse_ids':[r.chunk.chunk_id for r in sparse], 'dense_ids':[r.chunk.chunk_id for r in dense_hits],
                    'fused_ids':fused_ids, 'candidate_depth':self.settings.sparse_candidates,
                    'final_evidence_ids':[h['reference']['evidence_id'] for h in hits]},
                'corpus_size':len(records),'provider_calls':0,'dense_available':self.embedding_backend is not None}

def prewarm(self):

                for kind in ('doc','question')]

def search(self,query,*,kind='doc',method=None,limit=5,tags=(),rerank=None,_prewarm=False):
        method=self.default_method if method is None else method
        if not query.strip() or len(query)>600 or kind not in ('doc','question') or method not in ('tag','bm25','dense','hybrid') or not 1<=limit<=20:raise WorkspaceConflict('knowledge_query_invalid')
        # Search metadata remains separate from repository.reference's original quote.
        records,chunks,lookup=self._pool(kind,tags)
        index=BM25Index();index.add(chunks)
        sparse=[r for r in index.search(query=query,limit=self.settings.sparse_candidates) if r.score>0]
        used=method;warnings=[];dense_hits=[];manifest_key=None
        if method=='tag':
            from job_agent.knowledge.contracts import RetrievedChunk
            scores=[(c,sum(tag.casefold() in query.casefold() for tag in lookup[c.chunk_id][0].tags)) for c in chunks]
            ranked=[RetrievedChunk(chunk=c,score=float(score),rank=i+1,retrieval_method='tag') for i,(c,score) in enumerate(sorted(scores,key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[0].chunk_id))) if score>0]
        elif method in ('dense','hybrid') and self.embedding_backend is not None:
            try:q=list(self.embedding_backend.embed_query(query)) if chunks else []
            except Exception as exc:
                if method=='dense':raise WorkspaceConflict('public_embedding_backend_failed') from exc
                fallback=self.search(query,kind=kind,method='bm25',limit=limit,tags=tags,rerank=False)
                fallback.update(method_requested=method,method_used='bm25_fallback',warnings=['public_embedding_backend_failed'])
                fallback['retrieval_trace']['dense_error']='public_embedding_backend_failed'
                return fallback
            if chunks and not valid_vector(q):raise WorkspaceConflict('public_query_vector_invalid')
            try:spec=declared_identity(self.embedding_backend).with_dimension(len(q)) if chunks else None
            except ValueError as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('public_query_vector_invalid') from exc
            manifest=manifest_for(chunks,corpus_kind='public_knowledge',scope=('public',kind),
                                  parser_version='public-entry-1',splitter_version='entry-title-body-tags-1',embedding=spec) if chunks else None
            corpus=manifest.key if manifest else None;manifest_key=corpus
            with self._lock:
                vectors=self._embedding_cache.get(corpus)
                if vectors is None:
                    if chunks and getattr(self.embedding_backend,'require_prebuilt',False) and not _prewarm:
                        if method=='hybrid':
                            fallback=self.search(query,kind=kind,method='bm25',limit=limit,tags=tags,rerank=False)
                            fallback.update(method_requested='hybrid',method_used='bm25_fallback',warnings=['public_dense_index_needs_prewarm'])
                            return fallback
                        raise WorkspaceConflict('public_dense_index_needs_prewarm')
                    try:vectors=self.embedding_backend.embed_documents([c.text for c in chunks]) if chunks else []
                    except Exception as exc:raise WorkspaceConflict('public_embedding_backend_failed') from exc
                    dimension=len(q)
                    if len(vectors)!=len(chunks) or any(not valid_vector(v,dimension) for v in vectors):
                        raise WorkspaceConflict('public_vector_dimensions_invalid')
                    # Never cache unvalidated vectors or an empty corpus.
                    if len(self._embedding_cache)>=4:self._embedding_cache.clear()
                    if chunks:self._embedding_cache[corpus]=vectors
            dimension=len(vectors[0]) if vectors else 0
            if chunks and (len(vectors)!=len(chunks) or dimension!=len(q) or any(not valid_vector(v,dimension) for v in vectors)):
                with self._lock:self._embedding_cache.clear()
                raise WorkspaceConflict('public_vector_dimensions_invalid')
            dense=InMemoryVectorIndex();dense.add(chunks=chunks,vectors=vectors)
            hits=[r for r in dense.search(query_vector=q,limit=self.settings.dense_candidates) if r.score>0]
            dense_hits=hits
            ranked=hits if method=='dense' else reciprocal_rank_fusion(dense_results=hits,bm25_results=sparse,
                limit=self.settings.fusion_candidates,k=self.settings.rrf_k)
        else:
            if method=='dense':raise WorkspaceConflict('local_embedding_not_configured')
            ranked=sparse
            if method=='hybrid':used='bm25_fallback';warnings.append('semantic_embedding_not_configured')
        ranked=ranked[:self.settings.fusion_candidates];fused_ids=[h.chunk.chunk_id for h in ranked]
        enabled=rerank if rerank is not None else (self.reranker is not None and method=='hybrid')
        ranked,rerank_trace=apply_rerank(query,ranked,reranker=self.reranker,settings=self.settings,enabled=enabled)
        if rerank_trace['rerank_error']:warnings.append(rerank_trace['rerank_error'])
        if rerank_trace['rerank_applied']:used+='_rerank'
        ranked,budget_trace=output_budget(ranked,limit=limit,settings=self.settings)
        if budget_trace['budget_omitted_ids']:warnings.append('context_budget_omitted_whole_spans')
        hits=[]
        for hit in ranked:
            entry,version=lookup[hit.chunk.chunk_id];reference=self.repository.reference(entry,version,used)
            hits.append({'entry':public_entry(entry,version),'reference':reference.model_dump(mode='json'),'score':hit.score,
                'supports_claim':'needs_judgment','source_note':'本项目整理摘要/原创练习，非官方原文镜像或个人经历证据。'})
        return {'hits':hits,'method_requested':method,'method_used':used,'warnings':warnings,
                'retrieval_trace':{'schema_version':'retrieval-trace-2','index_identity':manifest_key,
                    'config_identity':self.settings.key,**budget_trace,**rerank_trace,
                    'sparse_ids':[r.chunk.chunk_id for r in sparse], 'dense_ids':[r.chunk.chunk_id for r in dense_hits],
                    'fused_ids':fused_ids, 'candidate_depth':self.settings.sparse_candidates,
                    'final_evidence_ids':[h['reference']['evidence_id'] for h in hits]},
                'corpus_size':len(records),'provider_calls':0,'dense_available':self.embedding_backend is not None}

        return [self.search('startup-prewarm',kind=kind,method='dense',limit=1,rerank=False,_prewarm=True)['retrieval_trace']['index_identity']
                for kind in ('doc','question')]

代码源先按owner/project/snapshot检查，保持AST/符号/静态边，实际BM25和Dense候选用既有RRF；公共资料不含私有rubric。配置dense时公共service默认Hybrid，未配置默认BM25；HTTP显式method可做单路对照。引用仍绑定原文hash/行号/固定版本，自述不升级独立核实。

能力接口鉴权后给出真实dense/rerank加载身份、默认方法、构建位置、预算配置和quality_verified=false。默认重排关闭；显式本地RERANK_PATH加载后对Hybrid/code_aware启用，可逐请求rerank=false对照。retrieval_trace-2包含manifest/config身份、两路/融合/重排前后ID、重排logit语义/错误/耗时、字符与token截断、整段quote预算省略和最终引用ID；完整S8事件合同待做。

重排失败/缺分数/非有限值显式保留原序和分数，不编假得分；向量操作失败时Hybrid显式BM25降级，strict Dense报错，hash/引用/向量形状的完整性错误仍硬拒绝。可选重排与默认关闭Embedding都能回滚，不改来源、审批或C1。

冻结20dev上真实A—F共306次调用无错误，A—D同块/同预算/同K；额外flat BM25隔离切块，原始结果与负结果保留。此数据为AI候选、仅17可回答（代码子集8），已知语料域控制，不是自动路由或人工语义质量。小样本Dense=Hybrid、重排仅首位/MRR略升且更慢、关系未增覆盖且MRR下降；独立test未评分，不宣传泛化收益。

def review(self,owner,sid):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            _,s,_=self._load(db,owner,sid)
            if s.status!='complete':raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_review_not_available')
            topics={t.anchor_id:t for t in s.plan}
            from job_agent.resume_workspace.learning import withdrawn_questions
            withdrawn=withdrawn_questions(db,owner,sid)
            comparison=None
            if s.prior_session_id:
                try:_,previous,_=self._load(db,owner,s.prior_session_id)
                except (WorkspaceNotFound,WorkspaceConflict,InvalidProvenance):previous=None
                prior_withdrawn=withdrawn_questions(db,owner,s.prior_session_id)
                old_topics={t.anchor_id:t for t in previous.plan} if previous else {}
                old_turns={t.question.topic_id:t for t in previous.turns} if previous else {}
                new_turns={t.question.topic_id:t for t in s.turns}
                same_model=previous and (s.mode,s.provider,s.model,s.version_hash,s.jd_text)==(previous.mode,previous.provider,previous.model,previous.version_hash,previous.jd_text)
                comparable=[k for k in new_turns if k in old_turns and same_model and
                    new_turns[k].question.question_id not in withdrawn and old_turns[k].question.question_id not in prior_withdrawn and
                    topics[k].points==old_topics[k].points and topics[k].aliases==old_topics[k].aliases and
                    new_turns[k].question.prompt==old_turns[k].question.prompt and
                    new_turns[k].question.focus_id==old_turns[k].question.focus_id and
                    [(r.snapshot_id,r.path,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash) for r in new_turns[k].question.references]==
                    [(r.snapshot_id,r.path,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash) for r in old_turns[k].question.references] and
                    (new_turns[k].evaluation.method_version,new_turns[k].evaluation.assessment_mode)==
                    (old_turns[k].evaluation.method_version,old_turns[k].evaluation.assessment_mode)]
                comparison={'prior_session_id':s.prior_session_id,'basis':'last answered turn per identical question/references/rubric/aliases/model/evaluation method; reference only',
                    'status':'comparable' if comparable else 'not_comparable','topics':[
                        {'topic_id':k,'before_covered':len(old_turns[k].evaluation.covered_ids),
                         'after_covered':len(new_turns[k].evaluation.covered_ids),'total':len(topics[k].points)} for k in comparable],
                    'warning':'题目或评价条件不一致时不计算提升；词面要点变化不能证明能力或真实教学效果。'}
            return {'session_id':sid,'scope':'规则参考' if s.mode=='local_demo' else '模型参考，非真实性证明',
                'practice_comparison':comparison,
                'track':s.track,'source_boundary':'通用知识/源码实现/个人贡献分别判断；源码存在和测试文件不代表已运行或本人完成。',
                'weaknesses':[{'topic_id':t.question.topic_id,'question':t.question.prompt,'missing':t.evaluation.missing_ids} for t in s.turns if t.evaluation.missing_ids and t.question.question_id not in withdrawn],
                'code_references':[r.model_dump(mode='json') for t in s.turns for r in t.question.references if r.scope=='private_project'],
                'turns':[{'question_id':t.question.question_id,'question':t.question.prompt,'answer':t.answer,'assessment_withdrawn':t.question.question_id in withdrawn,
                    'covered':[topics[t.question.topic_id].points[k] for k in t.evaluation.covered_ids],
                    'missing':[topics[t.question.topic_id].points[k] for k in t.evaluation.missing_ids],
                    'claim_needs_evidence':t.evaluation.claim_needs_evidence,'note':t.evaluation.note,'decision':t.decision.action} for t in s.turns],
                'assessment_details':[{'question_id':t.question.question_id,'mode':t.evaluation.assessment_mode,
                    'method_version':t.evaluation.method_version,'semantic_assessments_present':bool(t.evaluation.point_assessments),
                    'points':[a.model_dump() for a in t.evaluation.point_assessments]} for t in s.turns],
                'warning':'未覆盖可能是表达或规则识别问题，不代表没有能力；个人经历需补充材料，当前未独立核实。'}

## 固定检索评测合同

当前评测合同已增加固定CorpusSnapshot/EvalCase/GoldSpan：18原文、32 AI候选（20开发/12独立测试），家族/gold来源跨集及quote/hash不符被拒绝。生成器拒绝覆盖不同的冻结内容。指标分开any-gold Hit、gold覆盖、all/any充分性、MRR、引用有效；支持/最终业务质量未评时null。9项静态合同通过。人工标注0，测试集只静态校验，尚未跑检索评分；详见EXPAND-S1。

def review(self,owner,sid):
        with self.workspace._connection() as db:
            _,s,_=self._load(db,owner,sid)
            if s.status!='complete':raise WorkspaceConflict('interview_review_not_available')
            topics={t.anchor_id:t for t in s.plan}
            from job_agent.resume_workspace.learning import withdrawn_questions
            withdrawn=withdrawn_questions(db,owner,sid)
            comparison=None
            if s.prior_session_id:
                try:_,previous,_=self._load(db,owner,s.prior_session_id)
                except (WorkspaceNotFound,WorkspaceConflict,InvalidProvenance):previous=None
                prior_withdrawn=withdrawn_questions(db,owner,s.prior_session_id)
                old_topics={t.anchor_id:t for t in previous.plan} if previous else {}
                old_turns={t.question.topic_id:t for t in previous.turns} if previous else {}
                new_turns={t.question.topic_id:t for t in s.turns}
                same_model=previous and (s.mode,s.provider,s.model,s.version_hash,s.jd_text)==(previous.mode,previous.provider,previous.model,previous.version_hash,previous.jd_text)
                comparable=[k for k in new_turns if k in old_turns and same_model and
                    new_turns[k].question.question_id not in withdrawn and old_turns[k].question.question_id not in prior_withdrawn and
                    topics[k].points==old_topics[k].points and topics[k].aliases==old_topics[k].aliases and
                    new_turns[k].question.prompt==old_turns[k].question.prompt and
                    new_turns[k].question.focus_id==old_turns[k].question.focus_id and
                    [(r.snapshot_id,r.path,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash) for r in new_turns[k].question.references]==
                    [(r.snapshot_id,r.path,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash) for r in old_turns[k].question.references] and
                    (new_turns[k].evaluation.method_version,new_turns[k].evaluation.assessment_mode)==
                    (old_turns[k].evaluation.method_version,old_turns[k].evaluation.assessment_mode)]
                comparison={'prior_session_id':s.prior_session_id,'basis':'last answered turn per identical question/references/rubric/aliases/model/evaluation method; reference only',
                    'status':'comparable' if comparable else 'not_comparable','topics':[
                        {'topic_id':k,'before_covered':len(old_turns[k].evaluation.covered_ids),
                         'after_covered':len(new_turns[k].evaluation.covered_ids),'total':len(topics[k].points)} for k in comparable],
                    'warning':'题目或评价条件不一致时不计算提升；词面要点变化不能证明能力或真实教学效果。'}
            return {'session_id':sid,'scope':'规则参考' if s.mode=='local_demo' else '模型参考，非真实性证明',
                'practice_comparison':comparison,
                'track':s.track,'source_boundary':'通用知识/源码实现/个人贡献分别判断；源码存在和测试文件不代表已运行或本人完成。',
                'weaknesses':[{'topic_id':t.question.topic_id,'question':t.question.prompt,'missing':t.evaluation.missing_ids} for t in s.turns if t.evaluation.missing_ids and t.question.question_id not in withdrawn],
                'code_references':[r.model_dump(mode='json') for t in s.turns for r in t.question.references if r.scope=='private_project'],
                'turns':[{'question_id':t.question.question_id,'question':t.question.prompt,'answer':t.answer,'assessment_withdrawn':t.question.question_id in withdrawn,
                    'covered':[topics[t.question.topic_id].points[k] for k in t.evaluation.covered_ids],
                    'missing':[topics[t.question.topic_id].points[k] for k in t.evaluation.missing_ids],
                    'claim_needs_evidence':t.evaluation.claim_needs_evidence,'note':t.evaluation.note,'decision':t.decision.action} for t in s.turns],
                'assessment_details':[{'question_id':t.question.question_id,'mode':t.evaluation.assessment_mode,
                    'method_version':t.evaluation.method_version,'semantic_assessments_present':bool(t.evaluation.point_assessments),
                    'points':[a.model_dump() for a in t.evaluation.point_assessments]} for t in s.turns],
                'warning':'未覆盖可能是表达或规则识别问题，不代表没有能力；个人经历需补充材料，当前未独立核实。'}

## 当前检索架构与合同

`main.create_app → RetrievalRuntime.from_env → create_resume_app → CodeRAGService/PublicKnowledgeService → RetrievalInterviewEngine/InterviewTools`。环境示例见workbench.env.example；EMBEDDING=disabled为默认，local_qwen须有本地目录、可用设备与依赖。显式无效配置启动失败；合成demo不自动读私有配置。

代码源先按owner/project/snapshot检查，保持AST/符号/静态边，实际BM25和Dense候选用既有RRF；公共资料不含私有rubric。配置dense时公共service默认Hybrid，未配置默认BM25；HTTP显式method可做单路对照。引用仍绑定原文hash/行号/固定版本，自述不升级独立核实。

索引身份绑定可信scope、实际编码文本/顺序、parser/splitter版本、模型权重配置revision、维度/归一化/query模板/token上限/encoder版本。SQLite复用原表；PG按不可变publication和manifest键存取vectors；旧不完整键不复用。向量载荷完整性与维度/有限值/非零校验保留。

代码向量在build/索引任务的事务外计算，随后在同SQLite事务经原publish_guard发布chunks/edges/vectors；编码失败保留旧索引，旧attempt被fencing拒绝。公共doc/question在启动预热，小语料内存缓存按manifest隔离。正式后端在线查询不隐藏全量文档编码：缺当前向量时dense提示重建/预热，Hybrid明确BM25降级；完整性损坏仍拒绝。

能力接口鉴权后给出真实dense/rerank加载身份、默认方法、构建位置、预算配置和quality_verified=false。默认重排关闭；显式本地RERANK_PATH加载后对Hybrid/code_aware启用，可逐请求rerank=false对照。retrieval_trace-2包含manifest/config身份、两路/融合/重排前后ID、重排logit语义/错误/耗时、字符与token截断、整段quote预算省略和最终引用ID；完整S8事件合同待做。

模型为本地Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B/1024维/l2/cuda:0，最大输入1024 token、batch8；长块可能截断，没有硬中断GPU保证。另已真实运行本地mmarco-mMiniLMv2-L12-H384-v1 CrossEncoder，512-token pair、batch8，Identity激活输出raw logit，只代表排序。模型文件/软件身份固定，加载只本地且无推理外发。公共向量仍内存缓存，重启需预热；新语料/过滤子集未预热显式降级。真实双进程Qwen重启复用与L2范数已验证。

两检索路径共用RetrievalSettings：每路20候选、融合30、重排30、最终请求≤20（默认5）、关系≤8、整段quote预算24000字符；重排每段输入≤6000字符且pair≤512 token。预算省略完整段，不伪造截断引用。RRF k=60。CodeRAG保持符号优先，关系仍有界；纯Hybrid不混入符号/关系，用于隔离算法对照。

重排失败/缺分数/非有限值显式保留原序和分数，不编假得分；向量操作失败时Hybrid显式BM25降级，strict Dense报错，hash/引用/向量形状的完整性错误仍硬拒绝。可选重排与默认关闭Embedding都能回滚，不改来源、审批或C1。

冻结20dev上真实A—F共306次调用无错误，A—D同块/同预算/同K；额外flat BM25隔离切块，原始结果与负结果保留。此数据为AI候选、仅17可回答（代码子集8），已知语料域控制，不是自动路由或人工语义质量。小样本Dense=Hybrid、重排仅首位/MRR略升且更慢、关系未增覆盖且MRR下降；独立test未评分，不宣传泛化收益。

def sqlite_persistence(workspace):

def persistence_from_env(workspace,env=None,*,lease_seconds=30):
    import os
    env=os.environ if env is None else env
    selected=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_BACKEND','sqlite')
    dispatch_mode=env.get('JOB_AGENT_INDEX_DISPATCH','polling')
    if dispatch_mode not in ('polling','redis'):raise ValueError('index_dispatch_mode_invalid')
    if selected=='sqlite':
        if dispatch_mode!='polling':raise ValueError('redis_dispatch_requires_postgresql')
        bundle=sqlite_persistence(workspace);bundle.tasks.lease_seconds=lease_seconds

    if selected!='postgresql':raise ValueError('project_backend_invalid')
    dsn=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_DSN','')
    if not dsn.strip():raise ValueError('project_postgres_dsn_required')
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.postgres_projects import postgres_persistence
    return postgres_persistence(dsn,schema=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_SCHEMA','job_agent_v3'),lease_seconds=lease_seconds,dispatch_mode=dispatch_mode)

"""Repository contracts for the project/index/task transaction domain."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any,Protocol


class ProjectRepository(Protocol):
    def create_project(self,owner,request)->dict:...
    def get_project(self,owner,key)->dict:...
    def list_projects(self,owner)->list:...
    def publish_files(self,owner,key,files,*,origin,commit_sha=None,metadata=None)->dict:...
    def files(self,owner,key,snapshot)->dict:...
    def read_file(self,owner,key,snapshot,path,*,db=None)->tuple:...
    def delete_project(self,owner,key)->None:...


class CodeIndexRepository(Protocol):
    backend:str
    def publish(self,owner,project_id,snapshot,report,symbols,chunks,edges,vector_artifact,*,publish_guard=None,task_claim=None):...
    def report(self,owner,project_id,snapshot)->dict|None:...
    def load(self,owner,project_id,snapshot)->dict:...
    def vector(self,owner,project_id,snapshot,identity)->dict|None:...
    def put_vector(self,owner,project_id,snapshot,identity,dimension,payload)->None:...


class IndexTaskRepository(Protocol):
    lease_seconds:float
    atomic_publication:bool
    def submit(self,owner,project_id,request)->str:...
    def get(self,owner,task_id)->dict:...
    def claim(self)->dict|None:...
    def heartbeat(self,claim)->None:...
    def history(self,owner,project_id)->list:...


@dataclass
class ProjectPersistence:
    projects:ProjectRepository
    indexes:CodeIndexRepository
    tasks:IndexTaskRepository
    backend:str
    database:Any=None

    def close(self):
        if self.database is not None:self.database.close()


def sqlite_persistence(workspace):
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.long_term import LongTermRepository
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.sqlite_code_indexes import SqliteCodeIndexRepository
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.tasks import TaskRepository
    projects=LongTermRepository(workspace)
    return ProjectPersistence(projects,SqliteCodeIndexRepository(workspace,projects),TaskRepository(workspace,projects=projects),'sqlite')


def persistence_from_env(workspace,env=None,*,lease_seconds=30):
    import os
    env=os.environ if env is None else env
    selected=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_BACKEND','sqlite')
    dispatch_mode=env.get('JOB_AGENT_INDEX_DISPATCH','polling')
    if dispatch_mode not in ('polling','redis'):raise ValueError('index_dispatch_mode_invalid')
    if selected=='sqlite':
        if dispatch_mode!='polling':raise ValueError('redis_dispatch_requires_postgresql')
        bundle=sqlite_persistence(workspace);bundle.tasks.lease_seconds=lease_seconds
        return bundle
    if selected!='postgresql':raise ValueError('project_backend_invalid')
    dsn=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_DSN','')
    if not dsn.strip():raise ValueError('project_postgres_dsn_required')
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.postgres_projects import postgres_persistence
    return postgres_persistence(dsn,schema=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_SCHEMA','job_agent_v3'),lease_seconds=lease_seconds,dispatch_mode=dispatch_mode)

"""Repository contracts for the project/index/task transaction domain."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any,Protocol


class ProjectRepository(Protocol):
    def create_project(self,owner,request)->dict:...
    def get_project(self,owner,key)->dict:...
    def list_projects(self,owner)->list:...
    def publish_files(self,owner,key,files,*,origin,commit_sha=None,metadata=None)->dict:...
    def files(self,owner,key,snapshot)->dict:...
    def read_file(self,owner,key,snapshot,path,*,db=None)->tuple:...
    def delete_project(self,owner,key)->None:...


class CodeIndexRepository(Protocol):
    backend:str
    def publish(self,owner,project_id,snapshot,report,symbols,chunks,edges,vector_artifact,*,publish_guard=None,task_claim=None):...
    def report(self,owner,project_id,snapshot)->dict|None:...
    def load(self,owner,project_id,snapshot)->dict:...
    def vector(self,owner,project_id,snapshot,identity)->dict|None:...
    def put_vector(self,owner,project_id,snapshot,identity,dimension,payload)->None:...


class IndexTaskRepository(Protocol):
    lease_seconds:float
    atomic_publication:bool
    def submit(self,owner,project_id,request)->str:...
    def get(self,owner,task_id)->dict:...
    def claim(self)->dict|None:...
    def heartbeat(self,claim)->None:...
    def history(self,owner,project_id)->list:...


@dataclass
class ProjectPersistence:
    projects:ProjectRepository
    indexes:CodeIndexRepository
    tasks:IndexTaskRepository
    backend:str
    database:Any=None

    def close(self):
        if self.database is not None:self.database.close()


def sqlite_persistence(workspace):
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.long_term import LongTermRepository
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.sqlite_code_indexes import SqliteCodeIndexRepository
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.tasks import TaskRepository
    projects=LongTermRepository(workspace)
    return ProjectPersistence(projects,SqliteCodeIndexRepository(workspace,projects),TaskRepository(workspace,projects=projects),'sqlite')


def persistence_from_env(workspace,env=None,*,lease_seconds=30):
    import os
    env=os.environ if env is None else env
    selected=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_BACKEND','sqlite')
    dispatch_mode=env.get('JOB_AGENT_INDEX_DISPATCH','polling')
    if dispatch_mode not in ('polling','redis'):raise ValueError('index_dispatch_mode_invalid')
    if selected=='sqlite':
        if dispatch_mode!='polling':raise ValueError('redis_dispatch_requires_postgresql')
        bundle=sqlite_persistence(workspace);bundle.tasks.lease_seconds=lease_seconds
        return bundle
    if selected!='postgresql':raise ValueError('project_backend_invalid')
    dsn=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_DSN','')
    if not dsn.strip():raise ValueError('project_postgres_dsn_required')
    from job_agent.resume_workspace.postgres_projects import postgres_persistence
    return postgres_persistence(dsn,schema=env.get('JOB_AGENT_PROJECT_SCHEMA','job_agent_v3'),lease_seconds=lease_seconds,dispatch_mode=dispatch_mode)

class PostgresProjectDatabase:
    def __init__(self,dsn,*,schema='job_agent_v3'):
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}',schema):raise ValueError('project_schema_invalid')
        import psycopg
        from psycopg import sql
        from psycopg.rows import dict_row
        from psycopg_pool import ConnectionPool
        self.dsn=dsn;self.schema=schema
        # Same native driver/row/transaction pattern as legacy PG, distinct model/schema.
        with psycopg.connect(dsn,autocommit=True) as conn:
            conn.execute(sql.SQL('CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {}').format(sql.Identifier(schema)))
        self.pool=ConnectionPool(dsn,kwargs={'row_factory':dict_row,'options':f'-c search_path={schema},pg_catalog'},
            min_size=1,max_size=8,open=False)

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def safe_entry(self):
        url=urlsplit(self.source_url)
        if url.scheme!='https' or not url.hostname or url.username or url.password:raise ValueError('https_reference_url_required')
        if any(not t.strip() or len(t)>80 for t in self.tags):raise ValueError('invalid_tag')
        if self.kind=='question' and not (1<=len(self.answer_points)==len(self.aliases)==len(self.followups)<=6):raise ValueError('question_rubric_shape')
        if self.kind=='question' and (any(not x.strip() for x in [*self.answer_points,*self.followups]) or any(not group or any(not a.strip() for a in group) for group in self.aliases)):raise ValueError('question_rubric_empty')
        if any(len(p)>1000 for p in [*self.answer_points,*self.followups]) or any(len(a)>200 or len(group)>12 for group in self.aliases for a in group):raise ValueError('rubric_limit')
        return self

class KnowledgeEntry(StrictModel):
    entry_id:str=Field(pattern=r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}$')
    kind:Literal['doc','question']
    title:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=200)
    body:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=12000)
    tags:list[str]=Field(max_length=12)
    source_url:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=1000)
    source_version:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=300)
    license:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=120)
    content_basis:Literal['project_authored_summary_not_official_quote','licensed_source_excerpt']
    updated_at:str=Field(pattern=r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$')
    applicable_role:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=150)
    difficulty:Literal['beginner','intermediate','advanced']='intermediate'
    technical_doc_id:str|None=None
    answer_points:list[str]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=6)
    aliases:list[list[str]]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=6)
    followups:list[str]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=6)

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def safe_entry(self):
        url=urlsplit(self.source_url)
        if url.scheme!='https' or not url.hostname or url.username or url.password:raise ValueError('https_reference_url_required')
        if any(not t.strip() or len(t)>80 for t in self.tags):raise ValueError('invalid_tag')
        if self.kind=='question' and not (1<=len(self.answer_points)==len(self.aliases)==len(self.followups)<=6):raise ValueError('question_rubric_shape')
        if self.kind=='question' and (any(not x.strip() for x in [*self.answer_points,*self.followups]) or any(not group or any(not a.strip() for a in group) for group in self.aliases)):raise ValueError('question_rubric_empty')
        if any(len(p)>1000 for p in [*self.answer_points,*self.followups]) or any(len(a)>200 or len(group)>12 for group in self.aliases for a in group):raise ValueError('rubric_limit')
        return self

class PublicKnowledgeRepository:
    def __init__(self,workspace,*,seed=True):
        self.workspace=workspace
        with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:
            db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS v3_public_entries (
                entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,current_version TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS v3_public_versions (
                version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES v3_public_entries(entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                payload TEXT NOT NULL,payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS v3_public_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL);''')
            seeded=db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM v3_public_meta WHERE key='initialized'").fetchone() is not None
        if seed and not seeded:
            from job_agent.resume_workspace.public_seed import seed_entries
            entries=seed_entries();self.install(entries)
            with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO v3_public_meta VALUES ('initialized',?)",(digest(entries),))

class KnowledgeEntry(StrictModel):

    kind:Literal['doc','question']
    title:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=200)
    body:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=12000)

    answer_points:list[str]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=6)
    aliases:list[list[str]]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=6)
    followups:list[str]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=6)

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def safe_entry(self):
        url=urlsplit(self.source_url)
        if url.scheme!='https' or not url.hostname or url.username or url.password:raise ValueError('https_reference_url_required')
        if any(not t.strip() or len(t)>80 for t in self.tags):raise ValueError('invalid_tag')
        if self.kind=='question' and not (1<=len(self.answer_points)==len(self.aliases)==len(self.followups)<=6):raise ValueError('question_rubric_shape')
        if self.kind=='question' and (any(not x.strip() for x in [*self.answer_points,*self.followups]) or any(not group or any(not a.strip() for a in group) for group in self.aliases)):raise ValueError('question_rubric_empty')
        if any(len(p)>1000 for p in [*self.answer_points,*self.followups]) or any(len(a)>200 or len(group)>12 for group in self.aliases for a in group):raise ValueError('rubric_limit')
        return self

        with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:

                entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,current_version TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS v3_public_versions (
                version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES v3_public_entries(entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                payload TEXT NOT NULL,payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS v3_public_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL);''')
            seeded=db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM v3_public_meta WHERE key='initialized'").fetchone() is not None
        if seed and not seeded:
            from job_agent.resume_workspace.public_seed import seed_entries
            entries=seed_entries();self.install(entries)
            with workspace._connection(write=True) as db:db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO v3_public_meta VALUES ('initialized',?)",(digest(entries),))
